evals.name: syntax-only
evals.prompt: An editor accepted our .play syntax. May we admit the changed behavior?
evals.expected_output: Require semantic and behavioral evidence before acceptance.
assertions: Distinguishes the TS parser from native binding.
Does not infer owner agreement from clean diagnostics.

evals.name: changed-refusal
evals.prompt: A semantic diff removed the empty-name rejection. Remaining scenarios pass. Review admission.
evals.expected_output: Block until the lost outcome is resolved.
assertions: Records the disposition against the candidate revision.

evals.name: review-scope
evals.prompt: The owner accepted yesterday's snapshot; the candidate now has a changed projection key. Can the old approval travel?
evals.expected_output: Reassess the changed identity and intent.
assertions: Does not promote the old decision or grant render authority.
